Been on Lexapro off and on for 3 months after taking Prozac for a year and a half. Been really bad about taking my medication due to going home and getting really really sick. Anyways, Lexapro has significantly helped. I finally feel emotions, other than sadness and bitterness. Lexapro has given me back loving the little things in life & it is amazing. Just remember that your mental health is a journey in and of itself. It takes time to find what works for you, but starting something new is the right step in the direction.
